liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Jerry delivered a great solo during the performance of Row Jimmy; Row Jimmy features excellent vocals, standing out as a highlight of the show [19][25]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider transition is described as fantastic [18]
- **Built To Last** (1 review): Rated the best song of the night, featuring Jerry's effective horn effect solos [19]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): The Johnny B. Goode encore was characterized as rather bouncy [19]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Usually a throwaway tune, this version sparkles with raunchy, energetic life [20]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): The Playing In The Band to Uncle John's Band transition is a favorite [22]
- Jerry's intro to the song is a complete expression of why fans miss him [23]
- The Music Never Stopped jam is described as super jammin' with a phil-bomb drop [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-07-17.144302.Dak.boedicker.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 26 songs; 168 min [1]
- **gd1989-07-17.mtx.hansokolow.96230.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1989-07-17.150009.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 163 min [5]
- **gd89-07-17.sbd.unknown.17702.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 158 min; rated 4.81/5 by 77 [12]. Said about its sound: The recording features fabulous sound quality throughout the performance; The soundboard recording is described as killer, capturing the magic of the night; Vocals are crisp and clear, with well-balanced, fully audible instrumentation [18][22][25]

## Around the show

- Final sunny day at Alpine Valley, featuring an insane crowd and beautiful weather [18]
- John Dwork listed the highlights of this show as every damn note [20]
- A full moon was visible over the back of the stage during the song [21]
- A policeman estimated over 400,000 people present, though the venue holds 40,000 [21]
- A full moon was rising behind the band during the encore [1]
- A full moon was rising behind the band during the encore [3]
- A full moon was rising behind the band during the encore [5]
- The user got puddled during the drums section of the show [34]
- The show is a portent for the dream-shows of 1989 through 1991 [26]
- Despite a sluggish start, the band played its tightest show in years [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-07-17.144302.Dak.boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Dak Shotgun Mics>Sony WM-D6C Cassette Master(Maxell MX-90 Minute Metal Cassette For 1st Set,TDK MA 110 Minute [1]
- **gd1989-07-17.mtx.hansokolow.96230.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Recorded by Casey Coniff using Sennheiser 441 mics and a Marantz PDM 340; Matrix created by hansokolow in ProTools from SBD, DAT, and CDR sources [2]
- **gd1989-07-17.150009.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [5]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user, with FLAC conversion done in May 2020 [5]
- **gd89-07-17.sbd.unknown.17702.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > EAC > *Cool Edit Pro > mkwACT [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1989-07-17 Mon Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1282959089931/grateful-dead-1989-07-17-mon-alpine) [31]
- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1989-07-17 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2017/07/grateful-dead-1989-07-17-alpine-valley.html) [32]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Alpine Valley Music Theatre - July 18, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/july-18-1989) [33]
- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1989-07-17 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2017/07/grateful-dead-1989-07-17-alpine-valley.html) [35]

facts.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
facts.source: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP1's X-Y @ 90degrees w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP1 bisecting the X-Y Pair> Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M (Oade erase head removal modifications) w/Maxell MX90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Front Row of Lawn 8 foot stand.
